label: Sofa, L-shaped (sectional)
notes: Wants a CORNER — two walls meeting at the origin — not one wall. `w` and `d` are only the bounding box; `cells` gives what is actually occupied, and the inner corner of the L is free floor, which is where the coffee table goes. Handed: mirror to put the return on the other side. On a small PH living room this seats more than a 3-seat plus armchairs and leaves more floor, which is why it is everywhere.
